appContext.category: local FM radio station streaming app (Savannah, GA — Hip Hop, R&B and Throwbacks)
appContext.summary: The official app for Coast 99.3 in Savannah. Listeners stream the station live with background and Lock Screen playback, see the current song with album art and an LED equalizer, browse recently played songs, and get push alerts when a contest keyword drops on air.
forbiddenInterpretations: music streaming service like Spotify with playlists or on-demand songs

theme.style: Savannah after dark, with deep midnight navy skies, an electric-blue glow like a lit cable-stayed bridge over the river, and hot sodium-orange city warmth low on the horizon. The light is cinematic and nocturnal, with soft haze over the water, luminous reflections, fine grain, and long-exposure streaks. It feels energetic, confident and proud of the Lowcountry, like a radio station rather than a generic dark gradient. Backgrounds are bold but stay dark and calm at the top so the white headlines read clearly. The contest slide flips to a blazing orange for urgency.
